opening.argument: The presentation promotes Mirror Trading International as an investor opportunity built around a “sustainable business model trading forex using advanced intelligence software with bitcoin as the base currency.” It describes the system as “fully automated,” says “you earn Bitcoin daily,” and identifies “a hundred dollars in bitcoin which is the suggested minimum.” Viewers are directed to register a Bitcoin wallet, provide suggested Bitcoin funding, maintain a trading balance, and fund the account within seven days; it further describes referral and binary profit-sharing allocations. The arrangement therefore centers on passive trading returns and account funding, while its non-guarantee and historical-results limitations do not establish that deposits, trading, withdrawals, or returns were completed.
